addedFindings.title: Type with many members
addedFindings.rationale: Large types often become aggregation points for unrelated behavior.

architecture-review.json.review: Workbench-only snapshot omits external reference edges; direct csproj unchanged and prior five-project graph used for boundary orientation. Existing package advisory/MSBuild diagnostics remain; not a clean analyzer claim. Shared provider removes concrete catalog, source, Project and participant dependencies, using two explicit origin adapters through one selector. Shared pure content preserves original prompt bytes. Source reads use existing Application ports; no runtime partial, project reference, service location or second provider. Original read remains separate from live publication and manager activation stays gated.
architecture-review.json.addedFindingReview: One type-member-count finding on inherited participant; its interface-required methods delegate shared content/result behavior, while original material reading is cohesive and independently tested. 45 source lines, no large runtime or partial growth. No new cycles; existing diagnostics remain.

discovery-review.json.review: All expected source cases discovered; count executions, not deduplicated display names.

final-resource-reconciliation.json.outcome: 84 unit/codec cases pass. Registered runtime has5 passes and6 failures because fixture uses interactive saved-dispatch constructor for inherited session. Negative cases will all repeat with stronger refusal assertions. Remaining61 integration cases unexecuted. Earlier unattributed isolated database and denied cleanup paths remain preserved.

build-overlap-correction.json.reason: Integration build accidentally started before Unit build completed; terminate only verified owned build tree and rerun serially. No test proof inferred.
